### Revenue Allocation

**Current revenue allocation:** **60% Buy & Burn · 20% Market Liquidity · 20% OpCo**

For every **$100 of received offload revenue**:

- **$60** is allocated to **Buy & Burn**
- **$20** is allocated to **Foundation-managed market liquidity support**
- **$20** is allocated to **XNET Inc. operating expenses**

In other words, **80% is allocated to the Foundation/token side, but only 60% of total revenue is the Buy & Burn allocation.**

> **Settlement timing:** Projected revenue, payments received, transfers and outstanding balances can occur in different periods. The monthly values below therefore should not be expected to reconcile within the same calendar month.

*Current allocation: XIP-12 / XIP-13.1.*

# Community-maintained analytics for XNET network activity, infrastructure growth, revenue settlement, token emissions and verified on-chain burn activity.

# Network and accounting metrics use public XNET sources. On-chain burn metrics are derived from Solana through Dune.

# **Links:** [XNET Website](https://www.xnetmobile.com/) · [XNET Foundation](https://www.xnet.foundation/) · [XNET Docs](https://xnet-mobile.gitbook.io/xnet-mobile-docs) · [Buy XNET on Jupiter](https://jup.ag/swap?buy=xNETbUB7cRb3AAu2pNG2pUwQcJ2BHcktfvSB8x1Pq6L&sell=So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112) · [XNET on Solscan](https://solscan.io/token/xNETbUB7cRb3AAu2pNG2pUwQcJ2BHcktfvSB8x1Pq6L) · [Revenue Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/1NebqJ876SNlO4xPihfJWzsH-V0xzgeA-Qw8i5VcHDU4/htmlview?pli=1#gid=1205842263)
# **Monthly network activity, revenue-sheet billing GB and WiFi revenue.**
# **Revenue Settlement: How XNET WiFi revenue moves from payment received to Buy & Burn settlement.**
# **Buy & Burn: Verified on-chain Buy & Burn activity from XNET's primary BBB/liquidity wallet.**

## Data Sources & Methodology

**Network offload** — [XNET Network Offload API](https://xnet-offload-scraper.vercel.app/api/data)  
Daily network traffic reported by XNET's public offload feed. `network_offload_gb` represents network offload and is not the same metric as the revenue sheet's monthly billing GB.

**Device counts** — [XNET Device Count API](https://xnet-total-devices-api.vercel.app/api/history?limit=1000)  
Historical observations of total and operational XNET devices. Missing observation dates are left missing rather than interpreted as zero devices.

**Revenue, billing GB & token emissions** — [Public XNET Revenue Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/1NebqJ876SNlO4xPihfJWzsH-V0xzgeA-Qw8i5VcHDU4/htmlview?pli=1#gid=1205842263)  
The source for `gb_per_month`, projected WiFi revenue, payments received, Buy & Burn transfers, outstanding settlement balances and monthly `Total Emitted Tokens`. The sheet is automatically mirrored and normalized through the open-source XNET Community Data integration.

**Token price, market cap & DEX liquidity** — [DEX Screener XNET Solana API](https://api.dexscreener.com/token-pairs/v1/solana/xNETbUB7cRb3AAu2pNG2pUwQcJ2BHcktfvSB8x1Pq6L)  
Live Solana liquidity data across XNET pools. Price and market cap use the highest-liquidity valid pool where XNET is the base token. DEX liquidity is the summed USD liquidity of detected XNET Solana pools. `Implied Circulating Supply` is calculated as market cap ÷ XNET price and is not an independently reconstructed circulating-supply series.

**Verified burns** — [Verified Burn Query on Dune](https://dune.com/queries/8875337/12910786) · [Primary BBB/Liquidity Wallet on Solscan](https://solscan.io/account/5QsyByFVJcg7oN76Ma26KEDFQdHt1tsiVExK94zURzfd)  
Burn figures shown on this dashboard cover verified Solana burns associated with the current community-observed primary BBB/liquidity wallet. The public XNET revenue sheet identifies this address as an XNET burn wallet. These figures should not be interpreted as every historical XNET burn.

### Metric Notes

`network_offload_gb` and revenue-sheet `gb_per_month` are separate source metrics. They track similar underlying network activity but are empirically different and should not be treated as interchangeable. The public sources do not currently document the exact reason for the difference.

`XNET emissions per operational device per day` is calculated from monthly `Total Emitted Tokens` ÷ average observed operational devices during that month ÷ calendar days in the month.

`XNET emissions per network offload GB` is calculated from monthly `Total Emitted Tokens` ÷ the calendar-month sum of `network_offload_gb`.

These emissions-intensity metrics do **not** represent actual average deployer earnings.

Revenue stages are also kept separate: projected WiFi revenue, payment received, transfer to Buy & Burn and outstanding transfer balance may occur at different times and should not be assumed to correspond within the same calendar month.

[XNET Community Data](https://xnet-community-data.github.io/xnet-data-integration/) · [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/xnet-community-data/xnet-data-integration)

# XNET

### 📡 Turning WiFi into carrier capacity

Mobile connectivity needs more than cell towers. **XNET is a carrier-grade, neutral-host wireless network that turns enterprise WiFi into capacity for mobile operators.** Its Passpoint infrastructure lets compatible phones connect automatically and securely, without captive portals or app downloads.

XNET brings together carriers, venues and infrastructure operators to expand coverage where people use mobile data. Operators earn rewards for carrying that traffic, linking wireless infrastructure to the XNET token on Solana.

Explore the network’s usage, revenue, token supply and Buy & Burn activity below.

## Market & Valuation

XNET price, market capitalization and Solana DEX liquidity.

## Network Activity

Carrier offload, device growth and network productivity. Newly deployed devices can take time to complete carrier approval and begin offloading traffic.

## Commercial Performance

WiFi revenue, cash receipts and unit economics.

### Revenue Settlement · 60 / 20 / 20

For every $100 received: **$60 to Buy & Burn · $20 to liquidity · $20 to OpCo.** Half of the current liquidity allocation ($10) buys XNET on the market, bringing the **effective market-buy allocation to 70%**. The liquidity allocation supports trading liquidity; it is not added to the burn total.

## 🔥 Buy & Burn

Revenue-backed XNET purchases and burns.

## Supply & Ownership

XNET emissions, circulating supply and holder distribution.

## DEX Liquidity

Liquidity and trading activity across XNET pools on Solana.

## Sources & Methodology

**Network.** XNET offload and device APIs provide telemetry and device counts. GB in network telemetry and billed GB in the revenue sheet are separate measurements. Device productivity uses the monthly average of operational devices. A deployed device may be awaiting carrier approval before it starts offloading. The current calendar month contains partial data.

**Revenue.** The [XNET revenue sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NebqJ876SNlO4xPihfJWzsH-V0xzgeA-Qw8i5VcHDU4/edit) provides projected WiFi revenue, payments, transfers and scheduled emissions. Service-month revenue and dated cash receipts are separate. Projected revenue, payments received and transfers can cover different periods. Annualized revenue run rate is an annualization of recent revenue; P/S divides market capitalization by that run rate.

**Market.** DexScreener supplies pool prices, liquidity and rolling 24-hour volume. Price comes from the highest-liquidity XNET-base pool. Market capitalization = price × circulating supply; FDV = price × maximum supply. Provider pool snapshots do not measure guaranteed execution depth.

**Buy & Burn.** Burn charts cover the primary BBB wallet [5Qsy…URzfd](https://solscan.io/account/5QsyByFVJcg7oN76Ma26KEDFQdHt1tsiVExK94zURzfd). The historical unemitted-supply burn is excluded. Latest-burn amount sums burn events in that transaction. Cumulative burn percentage uses the published maximum supply of 1,307,098,713 XNET; the circulating-supply percentage uses the latest circulating supply.

**Emissions.** The XIP-11 schedule allocates 2.5 million XNET per 14-day epoch. Calendar-month totals prorate that rate by the number of days; schedule totals differ from the dates on which tokens are distributed.

**Emissions per GB.** Scheduled monthly XNET emissions ÷ network offload GB, for completed months. The USD series multiplies this ratio by the latest XNET price. It represents emission intensity at today’s price, rather than historical USD payouts or individual deployer earnings.

**Supply & ownership.** Month-end circulation is reconstructed from the September 24, 2026 supply checkpoint and the 61-wallet exclusion list, using transfers and circulating-token burns. Burning tokens from an excluded wallet reduces outstanding supply and the exclusion together, leaving circulation unchanged. Holders are positive-balance owners, not unique people. Bucket lower bounds are inclusive and upper bounds exclusive. Circulating-supply growth is the percentage change from the previous month-end observation; the current month uses its latest available observation.

**Coverage & source status.** Source dates in the freshness table indicate the age of each dataset. Offload/device sources currently retain their last observations while the APIs return HTTP 402. BBB USDC history starts on December 30, 2025. Daily closing balances are carried forward on days without balance changes, followed by current Solana RPC observations. Circulating-supply history starts on September 30, 2024.
